size_pct_nav: Orderly Partnership wind-down; not immediate disposal of all controlled businesses

drivers.driver: Quantitative opportunities had largely disappeared at the capital scale now required.
Buffett would not play an unfamiliar speculative game merely to preserve his record.
drivers.quote: I am not attuned to this market environment and I don't want to spoil a decent record by trying to play a game I don't understand just so I can go out a hero.

drivers.driver: The attempt to reduce effort without stopping had failed.
drivers.quote: The only way to slow down is to stop.

drivers.driver: He refused to grope for luck with partners' money.
drivers.quote: I have no desire to grope around, hoping to 'get lucky' with other people's money.

entry_valuation_stated: Scarcity of quantitative opportunities at ~$100 million scale, not a Dow price target.
outcome_note: Orderly liquidation and distributions with residual controlled holdings and workout obligations; not a market short.
sources: Buffett Partnership correspondence through May 29, 1969; factual opportunity-set reconstruction with the day's disposition and instructions withheld; https://focusedcompounding.com/wp-content/uploads/2018/04/Complete_Buffett_partnership_letters-1957-70.pdf
pack_quality_notes: Same-day decision paragraph withheld; pre-decision facts reconstructed from the letter. Personal retirement utility matters, so grading as pure macro timing is inappropriate. Exact cash and security values unrecovered.
